title: Firefly: Illuminating Large-Scale Verified Tool-Call Data Generation from Real APIs
abstract: arXiv:2605.17558v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training tool-calling agents requires large-scale trajectory data with verifiable labels, yet existing approaches either synthesize environments that diverge from real API behavior or generate tasks without ground-truth outcomes for verification. We present FireFly, a pipeline for generating verified tool-call data from real-world MCP servers. Our key insight is to invert the standard synthesis pipeline: rather than generating tasks and hoping they are solvable, we first let a strong LLM explore real APIs along graph-guided DAG structures, then synthesize tasks backward from observed outcomes, guaranteeing label correctness by construction. To handle the scale of real-world tool spaces (${\sim}$1,000 tools), we build a pairwise tool graph and sample sub-DAGs to focus exploration on semantically coherent workflows. To address environment drift in live APIs, we construct a retrieval-augmented simulator that caches all exploration

translated_title: Firefly：从真实API中点亮大规模可验证工具调用数据生成
translated_abstract: 训练工具调用智能体需要大规模带有可验证标签的轨迹数据，然而现有方法要么合成偏离真实API行为的环境，要么生成缺乏真实结果以供验证的任务。我们提出了FireFly，一个从真实世界MCP服务器生成可验证工具调用数据的流水线。我们的关键洞察是反转标准的合成流水线：不是先生成任务并期望它们可解，而是先让一个强大的大语言模型沿着图引导的DAG结构探索真实API，然后从观察到的结果反向合成任务，从而在构造上保证标签的正确性。为了应对真实世界工具空间的规模（约1000个工具），我们构建了一个成对工具图并采样子DAG，将探索聚焦在语义连贯的工作流上。为了解决在线API中的环境漂移问题，我们构建了一个检索增强的模拟器，缓存所有探索……
tldr: FireFly通过先让大模型探索真实API再从观察结果反向合成任务的新范式，从真实MCP服务器生成在构造上保证标签正确性的大规模工具调用训练数据。
en_tdlr: FireFly generates large-scale verified tool-call training data from real MCP servers by first exploring real APIs with an LLM and then backward-synthesizing tasks from observed outcomes, guaranteeing label correctness by construction.
